title: Malicious code in signed-manifest-guard (PyPI)
description: The signed-manifest-guard package version 0.1.7 on PyPI contains malicious code embedded in its installation process. Specifically, it overrides the install command in setup.py to execute malicious code that downloads and runs a remote malicious script, identified as a Remote Access Trojan (RAT). This behavior indicates the package is part of a campaign with clear malicious intent to compromise systems.
